reviews.text:
Super watery.
First layer: Barely any coverage
Second layer: If you finish with concealer it gives you a no makeup fresh look. But still quite light coverage.

If you touch up during the day you can maintain a covered look.
Living in Australia and my skin used to be very light but I’ve gotten a little tan since I’ve moved from Korea. 
Colour 01 Porcelain 17 is still perfect for my slightly tanned tone.
Puff is AMAZING. It helps to create a dewy, moisturized look.
reviews.zh:
質地超級水嘅。
第一層：幾乎冇遮瑕力
第二層：如果之後再加遮瑕膏，就會有裸妝、清新嘅效果。不過遮瑕力仍然好輕。

如果日間補妝，就可以維持有遮蓋嘅效果。
我住喺澳洲，以前皮膚好白，但係由韓國搬嚟之後曬咗少少黑。
01 色號 Porcelain 17 對我少少曬黑嘅膚色嚟講仍然好啱。
粉撲超正！會幫助營造水潤、保濕嘅光澤感。

reviews.text: This is a great cushion for those looking for light to medium coverage with a natural finish. I do not have perfect skin (acne, scarring, dark spots) but I find that this product has enough coverage for everyday use, paired with a concealer for troubled areas. For more natural days, it's great on its own. I have never used a net/mesh cushion before this product, but I like how it only distributes the product little by little. However, I brought this cushion on vacation, and since it wasn’t upright in my bag, a bunch of product came through the mesh (see photo). I'm still a fan of the mesh cushion, but be careful storing it if you bring this on a flight!
reviews.zh: 對於想要輕至中等遮瑕、同時有自然妝感嘅人嚟講，呢款係好好嘅氣墊。我嘅皮膚唔係完美嘅（有痘、疤痕、暗瘡印），不過我覺得呢款嘅遮瑕力已經足夠日常使用，如果有問題位，再配搭遮瑕膏就可以。如果係比較自然嘅日子，單獨用都好好。我之前從來未用過網狀氣墊，不過我鍾意佢只會慢慢咁釋出產品。不過，我帶呢款氣墊去旅行，因為佢喺袋入面唔係直立放，有好多產品透過網眼漏咗出嚟（見圖）。我仍然好鍾意呢款網狀氣墊，但係如果你帶佢坐飛機，收納嗰陣要小心！

reviews.text: I really like this cushion. Its the best moisturizing cushion on the market, the coverage is light to medium, but very buildable and smooth. I work 8 hour shifts in a restaurant, it doesn't crack or flake, and as You go throughout the day its gives Your skin a beautiful glowy look without looking shiny. The color matches me perfectly its insane, and with the long lasting, glowy, hydrating finish, its definitely worth buying! I've bought three by now, because its that good. Very good hydrating cushion, excellent for dry skin!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款氣墊。佢係市面上最好嘅保濕氣墊，遮瑕力係輕至中等，但係好易疊加、好滑。我喺餐廳做 8 個鐘嘅更，佢唔會裂開或者起屑，而且一日落嚟，都令你嘅皮膚有好靚嘅光澤，但係唔會睇落油油地。顏色啱到不得了，持久、有光澤、保濕嘅效果，絕對值得買！我而家已經買咗三個，因為佢真係咁好。非常保濕嘅氣墊，好啱乾性皮膚！

reviews.text: It's really hydrating and has a refreshing feeling when I apply it on my skin. I like it personally to give moisture to my skin, but it can make my nose and cheeks oily sometimes and since I use eyeglasses, I've noticed it can get cakey by the bridge of the nose, I guess I can apply some powder to avoid that. The shade is perfect for my skin, a bit brighter but just a little.
reviews.zh: 佢好保濕，搽喺皮膚上有清新嘅感覺。我個人好鍾意佢幫皮膚補充水分，不過有時會令鼻同面頰出油，而且因為我戴眼鏡，我留意到鼻樑位會易起餅，我諗可以撲少少粉去避免呢個問題。色號啱我嘅膚色，稍為亮啲，但係只係少少。

reviews.text: I really like this cushion because it makes my skin really glowy and it's not the sticky type of glow. It's super smooth. It doesn't have a big coverage, but I like it for more natural days. It feels like skincare mixed with a bit of foundation. The texture of the foundation is super watery. It was a pretty good shade match too. I also love the packaging!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款氣墊，因為佢令我嘅皮膚好有光澤，而且唔係黏黏嗰種光澤。好滑。遮瑕力唔係好大，不過我鍾意喺比較自然嘅日子用。感覺好似護膚加咗少少粉底咁。粉底嘅質地好水。色號都好啱。我仲好鍾意個包裝！

reviews.text: This is watery just like the name! I purchased this and the Clio cushion at the same time and unfortunately Clio is the winner for me. This is very light and does not provide much coverage, but it’s buildable. I have dry skin and this feels light on the skin and doesn’t cling onto my dry patches. Unfortunately I do have to use extra concealer on top. If you’re torn between Clio and this one, go for the Clio if you need a little more coverage. Both provides a nice glow and doesn’t cling to dry skin.
reviews.zh: 真係好似個名咁水水哋！我同時買咗呢款同 Clio 嘅氣墊，可惜對我嚟講 Clio 勝出。呢款好輕，遮瑕力唔多，但係可以慢慢疊加。我係乾性皮膚，呢款搽落好輕盈，唔會卡住我嘅乾燥位。可惜我都要喺上面加多少少遮瑕膏。如果你喺 Clio 同呢款之間猶豫，如果你需要多啲遮瑕，就揀 Clio。兩款都有好好嘅光澤，而且唔會卡喺乾性皮膚上。

reviews.text:
my skin tone: tanned asian skin with very warm/yellow undertone, Korean Foundation shade between 25~27
lips: slightly purple undertone, On the darker side of common East Asian lips

IF you have pretty clear skin and only want to add a glow that looks like hydration is overflowing from your own skin naturally, this is the product for you. 
I do have some blemishes here and there but acne free and using this product in the winter gave a great hydration and glow to my face. It's like "I didn't wear any foundation but my face still looks great" kinda cushion as the name itself says "Bare". hahah 

Don't expect coverage.
reviews.zh:
我嘅膚色：曬過嘅亞洲膚色，底調好暖／偏黃，韓國粉底色號介於 25 至 27 之間
嘴唇：底調稍為偏紫，屬於東亞嘴唇裡面偏深嗰一類

如果你嘅皮膚幾清透，只想加少少光澤，睇落好似水份由皮膚自然溢出咁，呢款就係你嘅產品。
我身上偶爾都有少少瑕疵，但係冇痘痘。冬天用呢款，令我面上好有保濕感同光澤。就好似「我冇化妝，但係我張面依然好靚」咁嘅氣墊，正如個名「Bare」所講嘅。哈哈

唔好期望有遮瑕效果。

reviews.text: Love this cushion! I never wear cushions cus they make me break out but I love this one! Super hydrating - but if you have dry patches it’ll still show but not as bad as other cushions. Coverage is great too. I got 21 Natural and it makes me look a bit pale (I’m more yellow-toned) but nothing that a lil contour and blush can’t fix! Def recommend
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款氣墊！我一向唔用氣墊，因為會令我爆痘，但係我好鍾意呢款！保濕超好——不過如果你有乾燥斑塊，仲係會見到，但係冇其他氣墊咁差。遮瑕力都好好。我揀咗 21 Natural，搽落會令我面色有少少蒼白（我偏黃底），不過只要一啲修容同腮紅就可以搞掂！絕對推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
